Acquire runtime capability:

Gmail mail sender.

Use runtime autonomous acquisition mode.

Capability identity requirements:

* Create a NEW runtime capability.
* Capability id must be: gmail_smtp_mail_sender

Constraints:

* Runtime language: Python
* Complexity level: basic
* Use Python standard library if possible
* Prefer smtplib and email.message
* Do not require external package installation
* Do not block on protocol or library selection
* Support Gmail service only
* Use smtp.gmail.com
* Use SSL connection on port 465
* Support Gmail App Password authentication
* Generate input schema
* Generate connection schema
* Generate secret schema
* Generate approval policy
* Store connection values through Agent Studio UI
* Store secret values in local runtime secret store
* Do not store secrets in generated code
* Generate runtime capability outside ai_core
* Verify by running a dry-run or mock Gmail test
* Register the capability after sandbox validation

Connection schema must include only:

* gmail_address
* from_address
* timeout_seconds

Secret schema must include only:

* app_password

Input schema must include:

* to
* cc
* bcc
* subject
* body
* html_body
* attachments

Approval policy:

* support always
* support once
* support never
* default mode: always

Verification requirements:

* verify capability id is gmail_smtp_mail_sender
* verify generated artifact directory is runtime/generated/tools/gmail_smtp_mail_sender
* verify smtp host is smtp.gmail.com
* verify smtp port is 465
* verify security mode is ssl
* verify app_password is loaded only from secret store
* verify input schema generation
* verify connection schema generation
* verify secret schema generation
* verify approval policy generation
* verify Gmail client initialization
* verify mock send execution
* verify registry registration under gmail_smtp_mail_sender

The capability acquisition is complete only after:

1. implementation generated
2. sandbox test passed
3. registry updated
4. verification run completed
5. runtime capability registered as gmail_smtp_mail_sender
6. execution profile generated
7. capability match contract passed
